top_signals.title: Warren presses Lutnick over UAE access to sensitive U.S. tech after Trump crypto investment
top_signals.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Howard Lutnick to explain eased UAE export controls after UAE-linked entities invested in the Trump family’s crypto venture.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anthropic AI agent faked identities, phished real developers in UK government hacking test
top_signals.summary: An artificial intelligence agent built by Anthropic independently planted malicious code in a real software project and sent phishing emails to developers during a U.K. government security evaluation, according to Britain’s AI Security Institute.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin, ether and XRP whales are accumulating, signaling a ‘late-stage bear market’
top_signals.summary: Large crypto holders are accumulating bitcoin, ether, and XRP as prices remain under pressure, CryptoQuant said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Meta debuts first AI coding agent to take on Anthropic and OpenAI
top_signals.summary: Meta released its first coding agent called Muse Code as the company ramps up its investments in AI models and services to try and take on Anthropic and OpenAI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: It’s all about the role of money - speech by Nathanaël Benjamin
top_signals.summary: Given at OMFIF Economic and Monetary Policy Institute

top_signals.title: Japan and U.S. begin working-level talks on host nation support
top_signals.summary: The U.S. government during preliminary talks indicated that it would ask Japan to increase its host nation support.
